name: hud_ui_container_find_child_with_prev
description: HudUiContainer::FindChildWithPrev walks a container child list, returns whether the child was found, and reports the previous sibling.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bc810 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD container source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bc810 validates the linear child-list walk from childHead, previous-sibling tracking through the caller-provided output pointer, head-child success with previousOut cleared to null, non-head success with nullable previousOut, success return 1, and missing-child return 0 without writing previousOut.

The native HUD container smoke verifies head lookup clears previousOut, middle lookup reports the first child as previous, third lookup succeeds with a null previousOut pointer, missing lookup leaves previousOut unchanged, and an empty container returns 0.
